questions.text:
Analyse how the world of the text shaped the choices available to one or more characters.

"World of the text" may refer to physical places as well as social, cultural, and historical contexts.

Write an essay on at least ONE written text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achieved (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology. Address how the text's world constrains or enables character choices. Show awareness of deliberate crafting. Include specific and relevant details from the text(s). Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion of how setting and context shape agency. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about the relationship between the text's world and character decision-making, making judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text(s).
